texts.title: 2023 年考研英语（二）阅读理解 Text 1

paragraphs.text: In the quest for the perfect lawn, homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut— and it is the environment that is paying the price. About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles. The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year’s event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos. The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
paragraphs.translation: 为了追求完美的草坪，全国各地的房主都在走捷径——而付出代价的是环境。塑料草每年售出约 800 万平方米，但反对声音现已蔓延至最高园艺界。切尔西花展已禁止在今年的活动中使用假草，并宣称这不是其精神的一部分。在伦敦西部举办年度展览的皇家园艺学会（RHS）表示，由于塑料草对环境和生物多样性造成损害，因此推出了这项禁令。

paragraphs.text: Ed Horne, of the RHS, said: “We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment.”
paragraphs.translation: 英国皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍恩 (Ed Horne) 表示：“我们去年推出了可持续发展战略，而假草不符合我们的精神和对塑料的看法。我们建议使用真草，因为它对环境有益，包括支持野生动物、缓解洪水和冷却环境。”

paragraphs.text: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes. A Twitter account, which claims to “cut through the greenwash” of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers. It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns. They have gathered 7,276 and 11,282 signatures.
paragraphs.translation: 英国皇家园艺学会做出这一决定之际，活动人士正试图提高人们对假草造成的问题的认识。一个声称要“打破人造草绿化”的 Twitter 账户已经拥有超过 20,000 名粉丝。它试图鼓励人们签署两份请愿书，一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草，另一份呼吁对此类草坪征收“生态破坏”税。他们已收集了 7,276 和 11,282 个签名。

paragraphs.text: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol. The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more. The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
paragraphs.translation: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪对环境也有影响，需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。该行业还指出，真正的草坪需要大量的水、除草剂或其他处理，而铺设人造草坪的人往往会更多地使用他们的花园。该行业还声称，铺设人造草坪的人平均在花园里的树木或灌木上花费500英镑，这为昆虫提供了栖息地。

paragraphs.text: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”. It added: “We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters. However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives.”
paragraphs.translation: 去年，另一份关于禁止假草坪的请愿书收集了 30,000 个签名，在回应时，政府回应称“没有计划禁止使用人造草坪”。它补充说：“我们更愿意帮助人们和组织做出正确的选择，而不是就此类问题立法。然而，人造草坪的使用必须遵守现有的法律和政策保障措施，以保护生物多样性并确保可持续排水，而加强生物多样性责任等措施应有助于鼓励公共当局考虑可持续的替代方案。”

breakdown.content: homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut— and it is the environment that is paying the price.
breakdown.explanation: 全句由并列连词 and 连接两个复合分句。第一分句为主谓宾结构：主语 homeowners（房主），后接介词短语 across the country 作后置定语；谓语 are taking 为现在进行时，表示当前普遍存在的社会行为趋势；宾语 a shortcut（捷径）。第二分句为“it is ... that ...”强调句型：主语代词 it；系动词 is；被强调部分 the environment（自然生态环境）；that 引导强调从句，从句谓语 is paying，宾语 the price（付出代价）。

breakdown.content: In the quest for the perfect lawn
breakdown.explanation: 句首介词短语作全句的目的与背景状语。名词 quest（追求）后接介词短语 for the perfect lawn（追求完美无瑕的草坪），点明各地房主采取走捷径举措的心理动机与审美驱动力。

breakdown.content: it is the environment that is paying the price
breakdown.explanation: 采用典型的分裂强调句型（cleft sentence）。将本处于受害受体位置的名词 the environment 提前进行强对比高光强调，与破折号前人类追求便捷的“走捷径”形成刺眼的讽刺反差，突出人造假草背后的沉重生态代价。

breakdown.content: homeowners ... taking a shortcut— and it is the environment that is paying the price
breakdown.explanation: 篇章总起立论句（Topic Hook）。开篇确立全文核心矛盾——“房主图省事的捷径”与“生态环境遭受的摧残”。破折号引出的转折因果警示直接奠定了 Q21（假草破坏环境有害生态）与 Q25（假草自始至终是一项极具争议的产品）的立论基调。

breakdown.explanation: 全句由并列连词 but 连接两个语义对立的分句。前一分句为主谓结构（被动语态）：主语为量词短语 About eight million square metres of plastic grass（约800万平方米的人造塑料草坪，中心词为不可数名词 grass，谓语动词采用单数 is sold）；时间状语 each year。后一分句为主谓结构：主语不可数抽象名词 opposition（反对抵制浪潮）；谓语动词为现在完成时 has spread（蔓延传播）；介词短语 to the highest gardening circles（至园艺界最高层级圈子）作方向状语。

breakdown.content: has now spread to the highest gardening circles
breakdown.explanation: 现在完成时 has spread 搭配时间副词 now，突出反对浪潮从散碎的民间杂音正式升格为行业殿堂级权威介入的历史转折；最高级形容词 the highest 精准界定了抵制力量的权威地位（即下文登场的皇家园艺学会 RHS）。

breakdown.content: eight million square metres ... is sold ... but opposition has now spread
breakdown.explanation: 数据对比与重大转折。前半句以年销800万平米的庞大市场体量彰显假草的泛滥，but 话锋一转引出顶尖行业圈层的强硬反击。本句直接为 Q21 排除 B 选项（偷换概念：园艺界是坚决抵制 opposition 而非热捧 hot topic）并为 Q25 排除 B 选项（销量巨大，并未出现 market share decline 份额衰退）提供核心判定依据。

sentences.text: The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year’s event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos.
sentences.translation: 切尔西花展已禁止在今年的活动中使用假草，并宣称这不是其精神的一部分。
sentences.slashed_text: The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass / from this year’s event , / declaring it to be not part of its ethos.

breakdown.content: The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year’s event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾结构。主语为国际知名展会专有名词 The Chelsea Flower Show（切尔西花展）；谓语动词为现在完成时 has banned（已明令禁止/封杀）；宾语 fake grass（人造假草）；介词短语 from this year’s event（自本年度展会活动起）作范围限定状语。

breakdown.type: 非谓语/伴随与补充说明
breakdown.content: declaring it to be not part of its ethos
breakdown.explanation: 现在分词短语 declaring... 作伴随结果状语，逻辑主语为主句主语 The Chelsea Flower Show。动词 declaring 后接“代词 it（指代假草）+ 动词不定式否定式 to be not part of its ethos（不属于其文化理念与精神内核）”构成复合宾语（宾语+宾补），宣示了主办方与塑料草坪划清界限的决绝态度。

breakdown.content: banned fake grass ... not part of its ethos
breakdown.explanation: 权威行动论据（Institutional Action）。作为园艺界“奥斯卡”的切尔西花展祭出禁令，以行业最高标杆的身份将抵制行动推向高潮。动词 banned 与 not part of its ethos 直接驳斥了 Q21 的 C 干扰项（声称假草在花展受到过度赞美 overpraised），彰显了花展坚定驱逐塑料假草的道德立场。

sentences.text: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
sentences.translation: 在伦敦西部举办年度展览的皇家园艺学会（RHS）表示，由于塑料草对环境和生物多样性造成损害，因此推出了这项禁令。
sentences.slashed_text: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) , / which runs the annual show / in west London , / says it has introduced the ban / because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
sentences.chunk_translation: 英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）， / 该学会负责在西伦敦 / 举办这一年度盛会， / 表示出台这项禁令是 / 鉴于塑料草坪对自然环境和生物多样性所造成的破坏。

breakdown.content: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) ... says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾（宾语从句）结构。主语为权威机构专有名词 The Royal Horticultural Society（RHS，英国皇家园艺学会）；谓语动词 says；省略连接词 that 的宾语从句 it has introduced the ban（它已出台了该禁令）作 says 的宾语；介词短语 because of... 作从句内部的原因状语。

breakdown.content: which runs the annual show in west London
breakdown.explanation: 关系代词 which 引导非限制性定语从句，先行词为 The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS)。which 在从句中充当主语，谓语动词 runs（运营/主办），宾语 the annual show（年度花展），地点状语 in west London（在西伦敦），交代 RHS 作为切尔西花展主办方的权威行业背景。

breakdown.type: 限制性定语从句（省略关系代词）
breakdown.content: the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity
breakdown.explanation: the damage 之后紧接省略关系代词 that/which 的限制性定语从句 plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity。从句主语 plastic grass，谓语 does，与先行词 the damage 构成动宾短语 do damage to...（对……造成损害），介词短语 to the environment and biodiversity 指向损害的承受客体。

breakdown.content: because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity
breakdown.explanation: 核心因果链条与直接题眼句（Q21正解定位句）。句中明确点出出台禁令的根本动因是假草危害生态和生物多样性，直接同义替换 Q21 正解 A 项（is harmful to the environment），同时以客观事实排除了 D 项（将举办地 in west London 移花接木拼贴为“破坏西伦敦景观”）。

sentences.text: Ed Horne, of the RHS, said: “We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic.
sentences.translation: 英国皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍恩（Ed Horne）表示：“我们去年推出了可持续发展战略，而假草不符合我们对塑料的精神和观点。
sentences.slashed_text: Ed Horne , / of the RHS , / said : / “We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not / in line with our ethos and views / on plastic.
sentences.chunk_translation: 来自皇家园艺学会的 / 埃德·霍恩 / 表示： / “我们在去年启动了可持续发展战略，而人造假草根本不 / 符合我们的核心理念以及对塑料制品的 / 审慎看法。

breakdown.content: Ed Horne, of the RHS, said: “We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为引述结构：主语 Ed Horne；介词短语 of the RHS 作其机构身份后置定语；谓语动词 said；双引号内的直接引语作宾语。直接引语内部由并列连词 and 连接两个分句：前一分句 We launched our sustainability strategy last year 为主谓宾结构；后一分句 fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic 为主系表结构，系动词 is，表语为介词短语 in line with 的否定形式。

breakdown.content: in line with our ethos and views on plastic
breakdown.explanation: 介词短语 in line with（与……相符合/契合）后接由 and 连接的两个并列名词 our ethos（我们的精神理念）和 views on plastic（对塑料制品的立场看法），介词短语 on plastic 作 views 的后置限定定语，阐明了机构对塑料制品抵制的原则性高度。

breakdown.content: sustainability strategy ... not in line with our ethos
breakdown.explanation: 权威专家证言（Expert Testimony）。通过引用学会发言人的官方表态，将抽象的 ethos 具象化为明确的“可持续发展战略（sustainability strategy）”，从宏观战略层面夯实禁令的正当性，强化 Q21 中关于 RHS 坚守绿色生态底线的论述支撑。

sentences.text: We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment.”
sentences.translation: 我们建议使用真草，因为它具有环境效益，包括支持野生动物、缓解洪水和冷却环境。”
sentences.slashed_text: We recommend using real grass / because of its environmental benefits , / which include supporting wildlife , / alleviating flooding and cooling the environment.”
sentences.chunk_translation: 我们强烈建议使用天然真草， / 因为真草具有显著的生态效益， / 包括为野生生物提供栖息支持、 / 缓解城市内涝洪灾以及降低环境温度。”

breakdown.content: We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment.”
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾结构。主语代词 We（代指 RHS）；谓语动词 recommend（建议/提倡）；动名词短语 using real grass（使用天然真草）作宾语；介词短语 because of its environmental benefits 作原因状语，说明提倡真草的生态环境理由。

breakdown.type: 定语从句与并列动名词
breakdown.content: which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment
breakdown.explanation: 关系代词 which 引导非限制性定语从句，先行词为复数名词 its environmental benefits。which 在从句中作主语，谓语动词 include，后接三个由逗号与 and 连接的并列动名词短语作宾语：supporting wildlife（扶持野生动物）、alleviating flooding（缓解洪涝灾害）以及 cooling the environment（为环境降温散热）。

breakdown.content: using real grass ... supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment
breakdown.explanation: 全句四处运用动名词：recommend 后接动名词 using 作宾语（recommend doing sth.）；从句中 include 后接三个动名词短语，精准排比概括天然草坪在生态栖息、海绵调蓄与微气候调节三大维度的正外部性效益。

breakdown.content: recommend using real grass ... alleviating flooding
breakdown.explanation: 正面方案建构与伏笔呼应。RHS 在痛斥假草后给出建设性替代方案，三大环境效益中的 alleviating flooding（缓解洪涝）与文末第5段政府表态中的 ensure sustainable drainage（确保可持续排水）前后呼应，点明天然地表对防汛防涝不可替代的生态价值。

sentences.text: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
sentences.translation: 英国皇家园艺学会做出这一决定之际，活动人士正试图提高人们对假草造成的问题的认识。
sentences.slashed_text: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
sentences.chunk_translation: 皇家园艺学会做出这一决定之际，环保倡导者们也正努力唤起公众对人造假草所致危害的认知。

breakdown.content: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓结构。主语为所有格名词短语 The RHS’s decision（英国皇家园艺学会的禁令决议）；谓语动词为一般现在时 comes（出台/发生，表时间与态势的交汇）；从属连词 as 引导时间状语从句。

breakdown.type: 时间状语从句与定语从句嵌套
breakdown.content: as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes
breakdown.explanation: 从属连词 as 引导时间状语从句（表示“正当……之际”）。从句主干为主谓宾结构：主语 campaigners（环保运动倡导者），谓语动词短语 try to raise，宾语 awareness of the problems；名词 problems 之后紧跟省略关系代词 that/which 的限制性定语从句 fake grass causes（主语 fake grass，谓语 causes），限定问题的根源。

breakdown.content: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness...
breakdown.explanation: 语篇视角平滑过渡（Transition）。从上一段行业官方权威机构（RHS）转向民间的草根行动网络（campaigners）。两大力量在时间维度上同频共振、在诉求上高度一致，有力驳斥了 Q22 的 A 干扰项（荒谬宣称活动人士对 RHS 感到失望 disappointment）。

sentences.text: A Twitter account, which claims to “cut through the greenwash” of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers.

breakdown.content: A Twitter account ... already has more than 20,000 followers.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾结构。主语为单数名词短语 A Twitter account（一个推特账号）；时间副词 already 作状语；谓语动词 has；宾语为数词短语 more than 20,000 followers（两万多名关注者/粉丝）。

breakdown.content: which claims to “cut through the greenwash” of artificial grass
breakdown.explanation: 关系代词 which 引导非限制性定语从句，先行词为 A Twitter account。which 在从句中充当主语，谓语动词 claims；动词不定式短语 to “cut through the greenwash” of artificial grass 作 claims 的宾语。短语 cut through 意为“看透/穿透/击破”，greenwash（绿洗/环保粉饰）指假草厂商将塑料制品包装成环保产品的虚假商业营销话术。

breakdown.explanation: 民间声量例证（Grassroots Evidence）。通过展示具体社交网络账号的破两万粉丝量，佐证反假草理念正在英国大众阶层形成强劲的社群动员力，揭穿假草伪环保的画皮，为下一句展示万人连署请愿书铺平叙事道路。

sentences.text: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns.

breakdown.content: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾补结构。主语代词 It 指代上文推特账号；谓语动词为现在进行时 is trying；不定式短语 to encourage people to sign two petitions 作宾语（encourage sb. to do sth.，people 为逻辑宾语，to sign... 为宾语补足语）；petitions 为 sign 的宾语。

breakdown.content: one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns

breakdown.content: calling for a ban ... calling for an “ecological damage” tax

breakdown.content: sign two petitions, one calling for a ban ... another calling for an “ecological damage” tax

sentences.text: They have gathered 7,276 and 11,282 signatures.

breakdown.explanation: 动词 need 后接动名词 mowing，构成英语经典的“need + v-ing”主动形式表达被动含义的句型（等同于 need to be mowed），生动揭示了天然草坪必须持续耗费人工与机械进行周期性修剪的维护痛点。

breakdown.content: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns
breakdown.explanation: 辩驳视角重大转折（Counter-argument Shift）。However 标志着论证视角的全面转向，由前两段对假草的声讨转入假草支持阵营的防守反击。支持者通过算“真草的环境账本（修剪耗电耗油）”进行防御，直接成为 Q23 核心定位句，命中答案 B（the disadvantages of growing real grass）。

breakdown.content: The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓+双重并列宾语从句结构。主语 The industry（假草产业界）；副词 also 表并列递进；谓语动词短语 points out；其后由并列连词 and 连接两个由 that 引导的宾语从句：① that real grass requires...；② and that people... tend to use...

breakdown.content: real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments
breakdown.explanation: 第一宾语从句为主谓宾结构：主语 real grass；谓语动词 requires；宾语由量词短语修饰的并列成分构成：considerable amounts of water（大量的水）、weed killer（除草剂）以及 other treatments（其他化学养护药剂）。

breakdown.type: 第二宾语从句与定语从句
breakdown.content: that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more
breakdown.explanation: 第二宾语从句中，主语 people 之后嵌套关系代词 who 引导的限制性定语从句 who lay fake grass（铺设假草的人，who 作主语，lay 为谓语，fake grass 为宾语）；从句主干谓语动词短语为 tend to use（往往更常使用），宾语 their garden，副词 more 作程度状语。

breakdown.content: requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer ... tend to use their garden more
breakdown.explanation: 递进辩护与 Q23 考点支撑。行业继续列举天然草坪耗费大量水资源、依赖除草剂化学喷洒等事实，与前一句共同构建起种植真草的三大缺点（耗能、耗水、化学药剂），彻底支撑 Q23 答案 B（the disadvantages of growing real grass）。

sentences.text: The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
sentences.translation: 该行业还声称，铺设假草的人平均花费 500 英镑在花园里种植树木或灌木，为昆虫提供栖息地。

breakdown.content: The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾（宾语从句）结构。主语 The industry；副词 also 表递进；谓语动词 claims（声称）；that 引导宾语从句。从句主干为主谓宾结构：主语 people；谓语动词 spend；宾语 an average of £500（平均500英镑）；介词短语 on trees or shrubs for their garden 作 spend... on... 的固定搭配状语。

breakdown.content: people who lay fake grass ... trees or shrubs ... which provides habitat for insects
breakdown.explanation: 句子包含两个定语从句：① 限制性定语从句 who lay fake grass 修饰 people，说明对象为铺设假草的业主；② 非限制性定语从句 which provides habitat for insects，先行词指代前面铺设假草后省下钱去购买树木灌木这一整体行为举措，故谓语动词采用单数 provides，宾语 habitat，介词短语 for insects 作限定。

breakdown.type: 谓语动词感情色彩与搭配
breakdown.content: claims that ... provides habitat for insects
breakdown.explanation: 谓语动词使用 claims（声称），透露出作者对行业利益集团单方面说辞的客观距离感；provide habitat for... 为生态学固定搭配，意为“为……提供栖息地”，行业以此论证自己不但不破坏生态反而间接造福昆虫。

breakdown.content: claims that people ... spend £500 on trees or shrubs ... provides habitat for insects
breakdown.explanation: 行业自我美化与干扰项破解。行业在此极力辩解铺假草能让业主腾出资金种树从而改善昆虫生态。命题人将其设计为 Q23 的 D 干扰项（将行业自夸“有益栖息地”歪曲为“面临保护挑战”challenges，以偏概全且曲解事实）。

sentences.text: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”.

breakdown.content: the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾（宾语从句）结构。主语 the government（政府官方）；谓语动词 responded（做出回应）；that 引导宾语从句。从句主干为主谓宾结构：主语代词 it；谓语 has；宾语短语 “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”（没有禁止使用人造草坪的计划），动词不定式短语 to ban... 作抽象名词 plans 的后置定语。

breakdown.type: 介词短语与非限制性定语从句
breakdown.content: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures
breakdown.explanation: 句首介词短语作背景状语。In response to（针对/响应……）后接名词短语 another petition last year about banning fake lawns；关系代词 which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 petition，which 在从句中作主语，谓语 gathered，宾语 30,000 signatures（3万个签名），点出官方表态所面临的庞大民意压力。

breakdown.type: 非谓语动词与介宾限定
breakdown.content: to ban the use of artificial grass
breakdown.explanation: 不定式短语 to ban 作 plans 的后置同位定语，介词短语 the use of artificial grass 作 ban 的宾语，字面界定了政府明确拒绝采取的极端一刀切禁令措施。

breakdown.content: the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”
breakdown.explanation: 政府官方定调与 Q24 排除基石。在民间请愿与行业辩驳激战正酣之际，政府以最高仲裁者身份表态“没有禁止计划”，为下文给出折中监管路径定调，直接从根本上排除了 Q24 的 A 选项（敦促立法禁止其使用 Urge legislation to restrict its use）。

sentences.text: It added: “We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters.
sentences.translation: 它补充道：“我们更愿意帮助人们和组织做出正确的选择，而不是就此类问题立法。
sentences.slashed_text: It added : / “We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating / on such matters.
sentences.chunk_translation: 政府补充道： / “我们更倾向于引导个人与机构做出明智选择，而非直接就此类事项 / 立法规制。

breakdown.content: It added: “We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为引述结构：主语代词 It（指代政府部门）；谓语动词 added（补充表示）；引号内直接引语作宾语。直接引语内部主干为主谓宾结构：主语 We；谓语 prefer（更倾向于）；宾语为不定式短语 to help people and organizations make the right choice；后接平行对比短语 rather than legislating on such matters 作对比状语。

breakdown.type: 宾语补足语与平行对比结构
breakdown.content: help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters
breakdown.explanation: ① 动词 help 后接复合宾语 people and organizations 及省略 to 的不定式 make the right choice（help sb. do sth.，充当宾补）；② rather than 引导平行对比状语，后接动名词 legislating 与前面的不定式动作形成政策取向上的鲜明对照（重在引导而非强行立法）。

breakdown.content: rather than legislating on such matters
breakdown.explanation: legislate 与介词 on 构成固定搭配 legislate on sth.（就某项事务进行专项立法）。政府在此明确否定了立法手段，强调以“帮助人们做出正确选择”的柔性治理机制替代刚性法律制裁。

breakdown.content: prefer to help ... make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters
breakdown.explanation: 治理哲学阐释。政府重申克制干预的政策立场，再次在逻辑上击溃 Q24 的 A 选项（敦促立法限制），为句末转折引出“恪守现行生态红线”的平衡法则做好逻辑蓄势。

sentences.text: However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives.”
sentences.translation: 然而，人造草的使用必须符合现有的法律和政策保障措施，以保护生物多样性并确保可持续排水，而加强生物多样性义务等措施应有助于鼓励公共当局考虑可持续的替代方案。”
sentences.slashed_text: However , / the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards / in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage / while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives.”
sentences.chunk_translation: 然而， / 人造草坪的使用必须遵守现行的法律法规和政策保障措施， / 以保护生物多样性并确保可持续排水， / 同时强化生物多样性职责等举措也应鼓励公共部门积极考虑可持续的替代方案。”

breakdown.content: However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage while measures ... should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives.”
breakdown.explanation: 全句由转折副词 However 开篇，主句后接对比状语从句。主句为主谓宾结构：主语 the use of artificial grass（人造草坪的使用）；情态动词 must 搭配及物动词短语 comply with 构成复合谓语（必须遵守）；宾语 the legal and policy safeguards（法律与政策保障措施），后接形容词短语 in place（现行到位的）作后置定语；while 引导伴随对比状语从句。

breakdown.type: 动词不定式作目的状语
breakdown.content: to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage
breakdown.explanation: 动词不定式短语作目的状语修饰 safeguards，由 and 连接两个并列动宾短语：to protect biodiversity（保护生物多样性）与 ensure sustainable drainage（确保可持续排水防涝），精准锁定现行法规约束人造草坪的两大核心环保指标。

breakdown.type: while 对比状语从句拆解
breakdown.content: while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives
breakdown.explanation: 从属连词 while 引导对比伴随状语从句（意为“在……的同时”）。从句主语 measures，介词短语 such as the strengthened biodiversity duty 作举例定语；谓语动词短语 should serve to encourage（应当起到鼓励……的作用）；宾语 public authorities（公共行政机构）；宾语补足语为动词不定式短语 to consider sustainable alternatives（考虑可持续的替代方案）。

breakdown.content: must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place ... consider sustainable alternatives
breakdown.explanation: 篇末权威结论与命题终极题眼（Q24正解定位句）。政府虽不专项立法禁止，但敲打提醒所有使用者必须服从现行法律和政策保障规范（comply with safeguards in place），完美同义改写 Q24 答案 C（Remind its users to obey existing rules）。句末“鼓励公共机构考虑替代品”同时排除了 D 选项（偷换主体且夸大动作为全面强制替代 Replace it）。

questions.stem: The RHS thinks that plastic grass _____.
questions.stem_cn: 英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）认为塑料草坪______。
questions.locate_sentence: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
questions.locate_sentence_cn: 在伦敦西部举办这一年度花展的英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）表示，之所以出台禁令，是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。

options.text_cn: 对环境有害
options.trap_type: 同义替换

analysis.practice_status: 牢牢抓住第1段末句'damage plastic grass does to the environment'，一眼即可秒选A项。
analysis.option_nature: 同义替换项。选项'is harmful to the environment'（对环境有害）是原文'damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity'（对环境和生物多样性造成的破坏）极其标准严谨的同义改写。
analysis.source_sentence: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
analysis.source_translation: 在伦敦西部举办这一年度花展的英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）表示，之所以出台禁令，是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。
analysis.locator_comparison: is harmful to the environment 与 damage ... does to the environment 达成无懈可击的同义映射。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者在开篇抛出'环境正在为此付出代价（it is the environment that is paying the price）'，随即援引英国最高园艺权威机构RHS的定论作为核心证据，选项精准切中立论支撑点。
analysis.theme_validation: 与文章通篇围绕人造塑料草坪破坏生态土壤与生物圈的环保反思主旨完全契合。
analysis.verdict: 精准对位：原文明确指出塑料草坪破坏环境与生物多样性，即对环境有害。

options.text: is a hot topic in gardening circles
options.text_cn: 是园艺界的一个热门话题
options.trap_type: 偷换概念 / 歪曲感情色彩

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易看到'gardening circles'原词，将其误读为园艺圈正在热捧假草。
analysis.option_nature: 偷换概念项。第1段第2句指出'opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles'（反对之声如今已蔓延至最高层级的园艺圈），园艺圈对假草的态度是严厉反对（opposition）与抵制，绝非将其视作值得推崇的'热门潮流话题（hot topic）'。
analysis.source_sentence: About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles.
analysis.source_translation: 每年售出约800万平方米的塑料草坪，但反对之声如今已蔓延至最高层级的园艺圈。
analysis.locator_comparison: 园艺界一致的声讨反对（opposition）被美化为中性或热捧的讨论焦点（hot topic），感情色彩严重偏差。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者突出的是主流园艺界与低劣捷径之间的尖锐对立，B项削弱了严肃的批判冲突。
analysis.theme_validation: 与全篇展现的园艺行业抵制、颁布禁令的主流立场不符。
analysis.verdict: 偷换概念：园艺界对其充斥着反对与抵制，绝非当成流行热门话题。

options.text: is overpraised in the annual show
options.text_cn: 在年度花展上受到过度赞誉
options.trap_type: 正反颠倒 / 违背事实

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易望文生义，误将花展禁令反向脑补为赞赏过度引来反弹。
analysis.option_nature: 正反颠倒项。第1段明确写道：切尔西花展直接对假草实施了封杀（'has banned fake grass from this year’s event'），并痛斥其违背了花展的精神内核（'not part of its ethos'），它在花展上遭到的是全面驱逐，从未受到过任何过度赞誉（overpraised）。
analysis.source_sentence: The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year’s event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos.
analysis.source_translation: 切尔西花展已在今年的活动中禁止使用假草，并宣布它不属于其展会理念的一部分。
analysis.locator_comparison: 被严令禁入（banned）且被定性为违背展会精神，却被选项篡改为受到盛赞（overpraised），公然颠倒是非。
analysis.writing_perspective: 花展主办方的态度是除恶务尽、坚决割席，选项彻底颠覆了主办方决绝的姿态。
analysis.theme_validation: 与RHS树立可持续标杆、拒绝塑料花展的理念背道而驰。
analysis.verdict: 正反颠倒：花展对假草明令禁止并坚决驱逐，绝非过度赞誉。

options.text: is ruining the view of west London
options.text_cn: 正在破坏西伦敦的景观
options.trap_type: 拼贴碎片 / 移花接木

analysis.practice_status: 抓取'west London'地理名词的考生容易落入局部细节拼接陷阱。
analysis.option_nature: 拼贴碎片项。第1段末尾出现'in west London'只是用来交代RHS每年举办切尔西花展的地理位置（'runs the annual show in west London'），作者指出假草破坏的是整体自然生态环境（the environment and biodiversity），从未声称它正在破坏西伦敦的市容市貌或视觉景观（ruining the view）。
analysis.source_sentence: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
analysis.source_translation: 在伦敦西部举办这一年度花展的英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）表示，之所以出台禁令，是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。
analysis.locator_comparison: 花展举办地（in west London）与生态破坏被强行拼贴成'破坏西伦敦景观'，属于典型的空间移花接木。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者论述的是全国性的生态危机（homeowners across the country），地理定语只是展会背景信息。
analysis.theme_validation: 将深刻的生物多样性生态灾难狭隘降格为某一城区的视觉景观问题，偏离主旨。
analysis.verdict: 移花接木：西伦敦仅是花展举办地点，未提及假草破坏该地景观。

questions.summary: 【题型与考点】事实细节题/观点态度题。考查对开篇第1段末句关于英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）对塑料草坪官方立场的提取。原文明确指出，RHS在著名的切尔西花展中对假草下达封杀令，原因是：'because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity'（因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成破坏）。随后第2段RHS发言人进一步确认其违背可持续发展理念。选项以'is harmful to the environment'对'the damage ... does to the environment'实现基石级同义改写。

synonym_pairs.text_term: the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity
synonym_pairs.logic: 同义转化：damage does to the environment（对环境造成破坏）直接同义转换为 is harmful to the environment（对环境有害）

synonym_pairs.text_term: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) ... says it has introduced the ban because of...
synonym_pairs.logic: 主体与观点出处精确对位

questions.stem: The petitions mentioned in Paragraph 3 reveal the campaigners’ _____.
questions.stem_cn: 第3段中提到的请愿书揭示了环保活动人士的______。
questions.locate_sentence: A Twitter account, which claims to “cut through the greenwash” of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers. It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns. They have gathered 7,276 and 11,282 signatures.
questions.locate_sentence_cn: 一个声称要“识破人造草坪的环保粉饰”的推特账号已经拥有超过2万名粉丝。它正试图鼓励人们签署两份请愿书，一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份则呼吁对这种草坪征收“生态破坏税”。它们已分别收集了7276和11282个签名。

options.text_cn: 对英国皇家园艺学会的失望
options.trap_type: 正反颠倒 / 逻辑倒错

analysis.practice_status: 考生若不理顺同盟关系，容易将活动人士对假草的愤怒错配给RHS。
analysis.option_nature: 正反颠倒项。第3段首句明确说明'The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness...'，活动人士与RHS站在同一战线，RHS的禁令是对活动人士倡导的有力支持与响应，活动人士根本不可能对RHS感到失望（disappointment）。
analysis.source_sentence: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
analysis.source_translation: RHS的决定出台之际，正值环保活动人士努力提高人们对假草所造成问题的认识。
analysis.locator_comparison: RHS与环保人士是相互呼应的盟友关系，选项却臆造双方对立与失望情绪，颠倒黑白。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者呈现民间力量（推特账号请愿）与行业巨头（RHS禁令）的同频共振，而非内耗冲突。
analysis.theme_validation: 与全篇强化反对假草统一战线的叙事背道而驰。
analysis.verdict: 正反颠倒：活动人士与RHS立场一致且相互呼应，并无失望之情。

options.text_cn: 对使用假草的抵制/反抗
options.trap_type: 同义替换

analysis.practice_status: 看出禁售（ban on sale）和惩罚性征税（damage tax）的本质就是抵制假草，迅速命中答案。
analysis.option_nature: 同义替换项。选项'resistance to fake grass use'（对使用假草的抵制）高度归纳了两份请愿书的核心诉求：一份要求立法禁售假草（calling for a ban on sale），另一份要求对其课以惩罚性重税（calling for an ecological damage tax），二者合力旨在从经济与法律层面阻击人们使用假草。
analysis.source_sentence: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns.
analysis.source_translation: 它正试图鼓励人们签署两份请愿书，一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份则呼吁对这种草坪征收“生态破坏税”。
analysis.locator_comparison: resistance to fake grass use 与 ban on sale / damage tax 形成本质属性的无缝对应。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者引入拥有数万粉丝的社交网络行动和征集了上万签名的请愿书，旨在展示公众对抵制假草的强烈声浪，选项精准契合民间行动的抵制内涵。
analysis.theme_validation: 承接上文的'opposition'，构成了全篇反思假草危害、掀起社会抵制浪潮的关键一环。
analysis.verdict: 精准对位：发起请愿要求禁售和征税，鲜明体现了对使用假草的坚决抵制。

options.text_cn: 对拟议征收的税款感到愤怒
options.trap_type: 因果倒置 / 歪曲立场

analysis.practice_status: 考生看到'tax'原词，极易按照常人'反感被征税'的惯性思维误选C。
analysis.option_nature: 因果倒置项。原文明确说明这项'生态破坏税'正是活动人士自己主动呼吁政府征收的惩罚性手段（'calling for an “ecological damage” tax'），活动人士是这一税种的积极倡导者，绝非对此感到愤怒（anger over）。
analysis.source_sentence: ...and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns.
analysis.source_translation: ……另一份则呼吁对这种草坪征收“生态破坏税”。
analysis.locator_comparison: 自己积极推动的税款主张，被歪曲成了令自己愤怒的外部税负，因果动机彻底反转。
analysis.writing_perspective: 环保主义者主张利用税收杠杆遏制破坏生态的消费行为，选项将其描摹成了抗税者。
analysis.theme_validation: 与环保倡导者运用政策工具倒逼绿色转型的行为逻辑严重冲突。
analysis.verdict: 因果倒置：活动人士是征税的发起倡导者，绝非对征税感到愤怒。

options.text_cn: 对真草供应短缺的担忧
options.trap_type: 无中生有 / 主客体错配

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易无端联想假草泛滥是因为真草不够用，属于典型的过度发散。
analysis.option_nature: 无中生有项。活动人士发起请愿关注的是假草对土壤微生态、昆虫栖息地造成的浩劫，通篇从未提及或担忧市场上天然真草的货源供应不足（real grass supply）。
analysis.source_sentence: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
analysis.source_translation: RHS的决定出台之际，正值环保活动人士努力提高人们对假草所造成问题的认识。
analysis.locator_comparison: 原文批判假草带来的生态公害，选项篡改为对真草供应链产能的担忧，风马牛不相及。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者探讨的是消费观念与环境伦理，非园林苗圃的草皮供需市场分析。
analysis.theme_validation: 脱离了全篇对人造材料破坏生态的环保反思轴心。
analysis.verdict: 无中生有：活动人士关心的是生态破坏，未曾担忧真草的供应问题。

questions.summary: 【题型与考点】事实细节题/推断题。考查对第3段环保活动倡导者发起请愿书诉求实质的理解。活动人士发起两项请愿：'one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass'（一项呼吁全面禁售塑料草坪）以及'another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns'（另一项呼吁对假草坪征收高额生态破坏税）。无论是全面禁售还是惩罚性征税，其共同目的均是遏制假草泛滥。选项以'resistance to fake grass use'（对使用假草的抵制抗拒）进行准确的高度概括。

synonym_pairs.text_term: calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns
synonym_pairs.logic: 同义归纳：呼吁禁售与呼吁开征生态破坏税，直接体现了对假草使用的强烈抵制（resistance）

synonym_pairs.text_term: campaigners try to raise awareness ... encourage people to sign two petitions
synonym_pairs.logic: 题干定位句精准对应

questions.stem: In Paragraph 4, supporters of fake grass point out _____.
questions.stem_cn: 在第4段中，假草的支持者指出了______。
questions.locate_sentence: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol. The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments...
questions.locate_sentence_cn: 然而，假草的支持者指出，天然草坪同样对环境有影响，天然草坪需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。该行业还指出，真草需要大量的水、除草剂或其他养护处理……

options.text: the necessity to lower the cost of fake grass
options.text_cn: 降低假草成本的必要性
options.trap_type: 无中生有 / 偷换论题

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易将商业辩护联想为降价促销，脱离文本。
analysis.option_nature: 无中生有项。第4段中假草支持者完全是在环保账本上与真草进行对比算账（比拼水耗、能耗与化学药剂），根本没有探讨降低假草的生产或销售成本（lower the cost of fake grass）。
analysis.source_sentence: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns...
analysis.source_translation: 然而，假草的支持者指出，天然草坪同样对环境有影响……
analysis.locator_comparison: 生态环境账本被偷换为假草制造销售的经济成本，议题完全脱节。
analysis.writing_perspective: 支持者意在证明真草同样不环保以洗白自身，而非讨论假草价格策略。
analysis.theme_validation: 与全篇围绕生态环境代价（paying the price）的论战焦点无关。
analysis.verdict: 无中生有：支持者是在论证真草的环境成本，未提及降低假草成本。

options.text: the disadvantages of growing real grass
options.text_cn: 种植真草的缺点/弊端
options.trap_type: 同义替换

analysis.practice_status: 梳理出天然草坪耗水、耗电油除草、洒农药的罗列细节，能迅速锁定概括项B。
analysis.option_nature: 同义替换项。选项'the disadvantages of growing real grass'（种植真草的弊端）是对第4段前两句事实细节的完美上义词抽象概括：天然草坪需要定期割草而耗费电能汽油（consume electricity or petrol）、消耗大量灌溉水（considerable amounts of water）、还要施加除草剂等化学养护（weed killer or other treatments）。
analysis.source_sentence: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol. The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments...
analysis.source_translation: 然而，假草的支持者指出，天然草坪同样对环境有影响，天然草坪需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。该行业还指出，真草需要大量的水、除草剂或其他养护处理……
analysis.locator_comparison: the disadvantages of growing real grass 与 environmental impact with natural lawns / consume electricity / water / weed killer 构成严密的事实-概括关系。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者秉持平衡报道原则，借支持者之口揭示出真草在现代城市维护中的高昂资源消耗，选项准确抓住了这一反驳立论的实质。
analysis.theme_validation: 精准呼应段落转折后的防御性论证逻辑：真草维护同样不环保且充满弊端。
analysis.verdict: 精准对位：支持者列举修剪耗能、耗水及除草剂污染，正是指出种植真草的缺点。

options.text: the way to take care of artificial lawns
options.text_cn: 打理人造草坪的方法
options.trap_type: 偷换对象 / 主客体倒置

analysis.practice_status: 考生看到'mowing'等养护词汇，容易误以为在教人打理假草。
analysis.option_nature: 偷换对象项。段落中谈到养护（need mowing, water, treatments）的全都是针对天然真草（natural lawns / real grass）的繁琐流程，假草的卖点恰恰在于不用频繁打理，文中并未讲解如何保养维护人造草坪（take care of artificial lawns）。
analysis.source_sentence: ...natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol. The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments...
analysis.source_translation: ……天然草坪需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。该行业还指出，真草需要大量的水、除草剂或其他养护处理……
analysis.locator_comparison: 真草的维护负担被偷换为假草的保养方法，施加对象完全张冠李戴。
analysis.writing_perspective: 假草之所以成为捷径（shortcut）正是因为免维护，选项与常识及文本设定均相抵触。
analysis.theme_validation: 文章讨论的是生态伦理取舍，非草坪家政操作指南。
analysis.verdict: 偷换对象：文中列举的是打理真草的麻烦，而非假草的保养方法。

options.text: the challenges of insect habitat protection
options.text_cn: 昆虫栖息地保护面临的挑战
options.trap_type: 以偏概全 / 曲解事实

analysis.practice_status: 考生扫到末句'habitat for insects'，容易断章取义误选D。
analysis.option_nature: 以偏概全项。第4段末句假草行业声称铺假草的人省下心力后平均会花500英镑购买树木灌木，从而'provides habitat for insects'（为昆虫提供了栖息地）。这是行业在鼓吹自己间接造福昆虫，而非探讨昆虫栖息地保护面临多大'挑战（challenges）'。
analysis.source_sentence: The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
analysis.source_translation: 该行业还声称，铺设假草的人平均会在花园的树木或灌木上花费500英镑，从而为昆虫提供了栖息地。
analysis.locator_comparison: 行业为自身辩护的有益论据（provides habitat），被曲解为面临严峻保护挑战（challenges），篡改了事实色彩。
analysis.writing_perspective: 行业在此拼命往自己脸上贴金，试图证明自己并不破坏生物多样性，选项篡改了行业的论述目的。
analysis.theme_validation: 与前文大篇幅论述真草弊端的核心内容相比，D项既曲解细节又以偏概全。
analysis.verdict: 曲解文意：行业声称自己为昆虫提供了栖息地，并非探讨栖息地保护的挑战。

questions.summary: 【题型与考点】事实细节题/提炼概括题。考查对第4段转折引入假草行业及支持者辩护论据的理解。面对舆论声讨，假草阵营反戈一击，列举了种植真草对环境的种种负面影响：1) 天然草坪需要定期修剪，消耗大量电力或汽油（consume electricity or petrol）；2) 真草需要耗费巨量水资源灌溉（requires considerable amounts of water）；3) 需要喷洒大量除草剂和化学药剂（weed killer or other treatments）。这些被支持者点名的硬伤，全部指向'the disadvantages of growing real grass'（种植真草的种种弊端与缺陷）。

synonym_pairs.opt_term: the disadvantages of growing real grass
synonym_pairs.text_term: environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol ... requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer
synonym_pairs.logic: 同义提炼：修剪耗油耗电、消耗大量水资源、需喷洒除草剂化学品等，全方位构成了种植天然真草的缺点与弊端（disadvantages）

synonym_pairs.opt_term: supporters of fake grass point out
synonym_pairs.text_term: supporters of fake grass point out that ... The industry also points out that...
synonym_pairs.logic: 原词论述主体完全契合

questions.stem: What should the government do with regard to artificial grass?
questions.stem_cn: 针对人造草坪，政府应该怎么做？
questions.locate_sentence: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”. It added: “We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters. However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage...”
questions.locate_sentence_cn: 针对去年另一份征集了3万个签名的关于禁止假草坪的请愿书，政府回应称其“没有禁止使用人造草坪的计划”。政府补充道：“我们倾向于帮助民众和组织做出正确的选择，而不是就此类问题进行立法。然而，使用人造草坪必须遵守现行保护生物多样性和确保可持续排水的法律与政策保障措施……”

options.text: Urge legislation to restrict its use.
options.text_cn: 敦促立法以限制其使用
options.trap_type: 正反颠倒 / 违背官方表态

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易将民间请愿的立法愿望错配为政府自身的行动方针。
analysis.option_nature: 正反颠倒项。末段政府官方答复中字字清晰写道：'rather than legislating on such matters'（而不是就此类事务进行专门立法），且明确表示'no plans to ban'，政府明确拒绝了匆忙立法的建议，选项却宣称敦促立法限制，完全反其道而行之。
analysis.source_sentence: We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters.
analysis.source_translation: 我们倾向于帮助民众和组织做出正确的选择，而不是就此类问题进行专门立法。
analysis.locator_comparison: 政府明确拒绝立法规制（rather than legislating），选项公然声称敦促立法（urge legislation），黑白彻底颠倒。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者呈现政府采取的审慎克制态度，避免过度干预私人花园，选项篡改了政府的执政逻辑。
analysis.theme_validation: 与全段展现的政府依赖现有制度、不增设专门法案的政策取向相悖。
analysis.verdict: 正反颠倒：政府明确表态不倾向于通过立法解决，A项彻底颠倒事实。

options.text: Take measures to guarantee its quality.
options.text_cn: 采取措施以确保其质量
options.trap_type: 无中生有 / 偏离监管重点

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易将一般商品质检监督的常识套用到人造草坪上。
analysis.option_nature: 无中生有项。政府关注的核心在于生物多样性保护和地面排水渗透（protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage），从未提及政府需要出面保证假草产品的工业耐用度或制造质量（guarantee its quality）。
analysis.source_sentence: ...to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve...
analysis.source_translation: ……以保护生物多样性和确保可持续排水，同时强化生物多样性职责等措施应当起到……
analysis.locator_comparison: 关注生态环保与城市防汛排水，被偷换为工业产品质量监督检验，脱离文意。
analysis.writing_perspective: 政府的角色是环境底线的守护者，而非假草制造商的质量认证机构。
analysis.theme_validation: 背离了全文探讨的宏观生态代价主题，属于无关常识干扰。
analysis.verdict: 无中生有：政府强调的是环保与排水合规，未提及保障假草产品质量。

options.text: Remind its users to obey existing rules.
options.text_cn: 提醒使用者遵守现有规定
options.trap_type: 同义替换

analysis.practice_status: 抓住政府表态末尾的'must comply with legal safeguards in place'，直接对应'obey existing rules'。
analysis.option_nature: 同义替换项。选项中的'obey existing rules'（遵守现存规定）完美对应了原文中的'must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place'（必须遵守现行就位的法律与政策保障规范）；'Remind its users'传神地契合了政府倾向于引导提醒（help people make the right choice）而非强制定罪的管理方式。
analysis.source_sentence: However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage...
analysis.source_translation: 然而，使用人造草坪必须遵守现行保护生物多样性和确保可持续排水的法律与政策保障措施……
analysis.locator_comparison: Remind its users to obey existing rules 与 must comply with safeguards in place 达成逻辑与用词的高度契合。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者在此交代监管现状：政府虽不一刀切出台禁令，但决不允许逃避现有的环保和防汛排涝法规，选项准确捕捉了这种敲打提醒使用者的平衡折中做法。
analysis.theme_validation: 与政府既不贸然立法、又不放任破坏生态的政策基调高度吻合。
analysis.verdict: 精准对位：必须遵守现行的法律和政策保障，就是提醒用户遵守现有规定。

options.text_cn: 用可持续替代方案将其取代
options.trap_type: 偷换主体 / 夸大职权

analysis.practice_status: 扫到末句'sustainable alternatives'原词的考生极易中招。
analysis.option_nature: 偷换主体项。末句明确指出'encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives'（鼓励公共市政机构考虑可持续的替代方案），政府只是在公共工程领域鼓励机构考虑替代，并未要求政府出面全面下场把所有人造草坪强制替换掉（Replace it）。
analysis.source_sentence: ...measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives.
analysis.source_translation: ……同时强化生物多样性职责等措施应当有助于鼓励公共机构考虑可持续的替代方案。
analysis.locator_comparison: 鼓励公共机构考虑替代方案（encourage to consider），被严重夸大为政府出面全面取缔替换（Replace it），偷换主体且夸大程度。
analysis.writing_perspective: 前文已表明政府'no plans to ban'，不可能转头由政府去强制全面替换，选项存在严重的内部逻辑矛盾。
analysis.theme_validation: 违背了政府奉行的克制引导原则，扭曲了文末的倡议语气。
analysis.verdict: 偷换主体且夸大动作：政府只是鼓励公共机构考虑替代品，而非亲自去全面替换。

questions.summary: 【题型与考点】事实细节题/政策立场题。考查对末段英国政府官方应对立场的理解。面对民间要求禁令的请愿，政府表态明确：1) 没有禁售计划（no plans to ban）；2) 倾向于引导人们自主选择而非出台强制法案（prefer to help make right choice rather than legislating）；3) 但话锋以'However'转折强调红线底线：'must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place'（必须遵守现行的法律与政策保障规范），即严格依循现有的生物多样性与排水规定。选项以'Remind its users to obey existing rules'（提醒使用者遵守现有规定）实现深度同义提炼。

synonym_pairs.opt_term: Remind its users to obey existing rules
synonym_pairs.text_term: the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place
synonym_pairs.logic: 同义替换：must comply with（必须遵守）转化为 obey；safeguards in place（现有的保护措施/法规）转化为 existing rules；政府表态转化为 Remind users

synonym_pairs.text_term: the government responded that ... It added ... However...
synonym_pairs.logic: 政府职责与立场对应

questions.stem: It can be learned from the text that fake grass _____.
questions.stem_cn: 从全文可以得知，假草______。
questions.locate_sentence: About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles... In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns... the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass”.
questions.locate_sentence_cn: 每年售出约800万平方米的塑料草坪，但反对之声如今已蔓延至最高层级的园艺圈……针对去年另一份关于禁止假草坪的请愿书……政府回应称其“没有禁止使用人造草坪的计划”。

options.text_cn: 正在被不断改良
options.trap_type: 无中生有 / 脱离辩论主线

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易从技术发展角度臆断商品必定在迭代改良。
analysis.option_nature: 无中生有项。全篇辩论的焦点是假草作为塑料制品所带来的不可降解性与生态剥削，以及真草维护的资源消耗，文章自始至终未曾提及假草本身的生产材料、工艺或仿真技术正在被不断改良升级（improved continuously）。
analysis.source_sentence: About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles.
analysis.source_translation: 每年售出约800万平方米的塑料草坪，但反对之声如今已蔓延至最高层级的园艺圈。
analysis.locator_comparison: 原文争论的是假草的使用伦理与环境代价，选项脱离文本无端臆造技术进步过程。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者关注的是生态文明与消费习惯的博弈，非工业制造工艺测评报告。
analysis.theme_validation: 与全文探讨社会接受度争议的主题脱节。
analysis.verdict: 无中生有：全文探讨的是伦理与生态争议，未提及假草产品本身在不断改良。

options.text: has seen a market share decline
options.text_cn: 经历了市场份额的下滑
options.trap_type: 正反颠倒 / 曲解销售数据

analysis.practice_status: 考生看到声势浩大的反对与请愿，容易武断推断市场销量下滑。
analysis.option_nature: 正反颠倒项。第1段明确指出假草在英国每年售出高达约800万平方米（'About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year'），正是因为其在家庭园艺市场大行其道、不断扩张，才引发了传统园艺界和环保人士的深重忧虑，完全不存在市场份额下滑（market share decline）的事实。
analysis.source_sentence: In the quest for the perfect lawn, homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut... About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year...
analysis.source_translation: 在追求完美草坪的过程中，全国各地的房主正在走捷径……每年售出约800万平方米的塑料草坪……
analysis.locator_comparison: 庞大的销量和流行的势头被主观臆断为市场萎缩，缺乏数据依据且正反颠倒。
analysis.writing_perspective: 正因为假草销量惊人、捷径诱惑力大，才迫使各大机构联合发起阻击，B项颠倒了供需现实。
analysis.theme_validation: 若市场早已自行衰退，全英范围内的激烈社会论战便失去了现实紧迫性。
analysis.verdict: 正反颠倒：每年销售达800万平方米，假草正在大行其道，并未出现份额下滑。

options.text_cn: 正变得越来越便宜/负担得起
options.trap_type: 无中生有 / 脱离价格讨论

analysis.practice_status: 考生容易根据大工业塑料量产的常识推断其越来越廉价。
analysis.option_nature: 无中生有项。第1段将购买假草定性为走捷径（taking a shortcut），主要图的是省去割草浇水的劳力麻烦；文中唯一提到的价格是假草主人在花木上花费500英镑，全文从未谈及假草自身的价格走势是否变得越来越经济亲民（increasingly affordable）。
analysis.source_sentence: In the quest for the perfect lawn, homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut— and it is the environment that is paying the price.
analysis.source_translation: 在追求完美草坪的过程中，全国各地的房主正在走捷径——而付出代价的正是环境。
analysis.locator_comparison: 图省事的行为动机被曲解为商品价格越来越便宜，概念完全偏离。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者强调的是环境付出了代价（environment is paying the price），而非消费者省了多少钱。
analysis.theme_validation: 属于脱离文本讨论轴线的臆造干扰项。
analysis.verdict: 无中生有：全文讨论的是免打理的便捷与生态代价，未提及价格越来越便宜。

options.text_cn: 一直是一个极具争议的产品
options.trap_type: 同义替换

analysis.practice_status: 通读全文正反双方的唇枪舌剑与政府的两难权衡，毫无悬念锁定D项。
analysis.option_nature: 同义替换项。选项'has been a controversial product'（一直是一个极具争议的产品）是对全篇行文结构的最高度凝练总结：第1、2段RHS因破坏生态将其从花展除名；第3段环保人士请愿禁售与开征惩罚税；第4段支持者与行业激烈反驳称真草更费电费水；第5段政府出面拒绝一刀切禁令但重申环保底线。通篇充斥着多方阵营的博弈交锋，'controversial'一词可谓精准入微。
analysis.source_sentence: About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles... However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns... In response... the government responded that it has “no plans to ban...”
analysis.source_translation: 每年售出约800万平方米的塑料草坪，但反对之声如今已蔓延至最高层级的园艺圈……然而，假草的支持者指出，天然草坪同样对环境有影响……针对请愿，政府回应称其“没有禁止的计划”……
analysis.locator_comparison: has been a controversial product 完美统领全文 opposition / ban / petitions / supporters / government responded 的整体交锋脉络。
analysis.writing_perspective: 作者全方位客观呈现了赞成方、反对方、行业协会与政府部门的多角力场，通篇旨在展示争议之大，选项直击文章灵魂。
analysis.theme_validation: 与全篇'捷径诱惑VS生态代价'、'真草负担VS假草污染'的争议冲突主旨完全融为一体。
analysis.verdict: 精准对位：全篇展现各方关于假草的激烈辩论与交锋，说明它是一个极具争议的产品。

questions.summary: 【题型与考点】全文主旨推断题/总结归纳题。考查对全篇围绕人造塑料草坪社会与生态评价核心态度的综合洞察。文章全景展现了激烈的阵营博弈：1) 销售火爆但顶级花展明令禁入，知名园艺学会斥其破坏环境；2) 环保斗士在网络发起万人请愿要求立法禁售并开征生态税；3) 行业与拥护者反击指责天然真草修剪耗油、灌溉耗水更不环保；4) 政府在请愿压力下坚称不予禁止但必须遵守现有法律底线。全文通篇充斥着针锋相对的辩论，直接证明了假草'has been a controversial product'（一直是一个极具争议性的商品）。

synonym_pairs.text_term: shortcut ... paying the price ... opposition has spread ... ban ... petitions ... However, supporters point out ... no plans to ban
synonym_pairs.logic: 主旨宏观提炼：禁令、万人请愿、正反双方针锋相对的辩论，无可辩驳地证明假草从诞生到流行始终是一个极具争议的商品（controversial product）

synonym_pairs.text_term: plastic grass / artificial grass / fake lawns
synonym_pairs.logic: 统摄全文讨论核心客体

macro_logic.genre: 城市生态与环境规制思辨型评述
macro_logic.discourse_model: 塑料人造草坪风靡现象 ➔ 园艺界禁令与生态抗议 ➔ 塑胶草皮的微塑料与热岛危害 ➔ 行业辩护（节水省力免农药） ➔ 政府审慎规制与治理平衡
macro_logic.main_theme: 本文深入剖析英国中产家庭掀起的'人造塑料草坪'（artificial plastic lawns）消费热潮背后的生态伦理与政策拉锯战；详述了皇家园艺学会（RHS）禁绝塑胶草皮的环保立场与社交媒体反塑胶倡议；全景式比对了塑胶草皮引发的城市热岛、土壤透气透水性破坏及微塑料污染，与天然草坪耗水、化肥农药径流及燃油割草碳排的现实困境；最终立足英国政府在禁止请愿下的政策回应，探讨现代城市绿化治理在便利性与生物多样性之间的精妙权衡。

paragraph_functions.role: 【起】完美草坪执念催生人造草皮消费捷径
paragraph_functions.core_point: 为追求常绿且免维护的'完美草坪'，越来越多英国家庭以塑料人造草皮替代天然草坪，却将生态成本转嫁给了自然环境。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 以反差修辞（shortcut vs. environment is paying the price）开篇立论。

paragraph_functions.role: 【承】皇家园艺学会带头抵制与绿色倡议
paragraph_functions.core_point: 英国皇家园艺学会（RHS）正式在其花展中封杀人造草皮，强调塑料草坪与绿色可持续发展战略水火不容。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 引入权威学术与行业组织声明，赋予议题严谨的环保政策基调。

paragraph_functions.role: 【承】民间环保抗议与生态灾难警示
paragraph_functions.core_point: 环保抗议者建立社媒账号痛陈塑料草坪破坏土壤微生物、阻隔昆虫鸟类觅食、加剧城市热岛与微塑料污染等严重环境恶果。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 从宏观行业抵制延伸至微观城市生态学机理，递进剖析生态危害。

paragraph_functions.role: 【转】支持阵营辩护：天然草坪的维护代价与资源消耗
paragraph_functions.core_point: 人造草皮支持者与制造商反驳称，传统草坪需耗费海量淡水灌溉，依赖化学杀虫剂除草剂，燃油割草机亦产生大量温室气体。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 运用转折连词（However），辩证呈现对立双方的论据对抗。

paragraph_functions.role: 【合】政府回应请愿：在全面禁令和精细化规制间寻求平衡
paragraph_functions.core_point: 面对数万公民的全面禁令请愿，政府表态不实施'一刀切'式立法取缔，而是强化排水许可与规划标准，引导公众知情理性抉择。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 由民间舆论对抗过渡至公共治理决策层面，实现论题闭环。

part_b_training.title: 英语二新题型（小标题对应）全真模拟演练
part_b_training.instruction: 阅读 Text 1 的五个段落，从 A-G 七个候选项中为各段选出最精准概括段落主旨的小标题（含 2 个干扰项）：

options.heading: Total Ban on Plastic Imports Imposed Across Britain
options.trap_analysis: 【❌干扰陷阱：过度泛化/虚假扩大】文章仅探讨人造草坪（fake grass）的使用争议，绝非在全英全面禁止所有塑料进口。

options.heading: RHS Stands Firm by Banning Plastic Grass from Garden Shows
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】精准归纳第2段核心事实：皇家园艺学会贯彻可持续发展战略，在所有园艺展中全面封杀塑料草坪。

options.heading: Proponents Defend Synthetics by Citing Natural Lawn Footprints
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】准确提炼第4段人造草支持者的反驳理由：天然草坪的灌溉、化肥与割草机燃油同样具备沉重环境足迹。

options.heading: Robotic Mowers Completely Eliminate Greenhouse Emissions
options.trap_analysis: 【❌干扰陷阱：无中生有】文中未提及割草机器人，更未断言其消除温室气体排放。

options.heading: Homeowners Seek Convenience While the Planet Pays the Bill
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】精准概括第1段：居民为求便利在后院铺设塑料草皮，环境却为此承担巨大代价。

options.heading: Government Eschews Blanket Bans in Favor of Planning Oversight
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】高度概括末段政府的立场：拒绝一刀切式全面禁止，转而依托规划指引与排水标准实施精细治理。

options.heading: Grassroots Activists Expose Biodiversity Loss and Urban Heat
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】精准对应第3段民间环保活动家通过社交媒体揭露人造草坪破坏土壤透水性、热岛与生物灭绝危机。

part_b_training.skills_breakdown: 【小标题答题要诀】：抓住关键词对应，段1（shortcut / pays the bill）、段2（RHS / ban）、段3（campaigners / damage）、段4（supporters / natural lawn costs）、段5（government response / planning regulations）；排除无中生有与概念夸大项。

writing_corpus.expression: witness an explosive surge in popularity across ...
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 现象描述谓语动宾结构
writing_corpus.translation: 在……范围内经历爆发式普及与急剧增长
writing_corpus.application_sentence: As is vividly illustrated by the chart, eco-unfriendly consumer conveniences have witnessed an explosive surge in popularity across urban households.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 正如该图表所生动展现的，诸如此类牺牲环境以换取生活便利的消费品，在城市家庭中经历了一轮爆发式普及与急剧增长。
writing_corpus.template_slot: As is vividly demonstrated in the graph, [某项技术/消费新习惯] has witnessed an explosive surge in popularity across [目标群体/特定区域].

writing_corpus.expression: prioritize immediate convenience at the expense of long-term ecological health
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 介词伴随因果评判句
writing_corpus.translation: 以牺牲长远生态健康为沉重代价，片面追求眼前的即时便利
writing_corpus.application_sentence: The crux of the matter lies in modern consumers' inclination to prioritize immediate convenience at the expense of long-term ecological health.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 该问题的核心症结在于，现代消费者往往倾向于以牺牲长远生态健康为代价，片面贪图当下的即时便利与省心。
writing_corpus.template_slot: The crux of the controversy is that [某群体] tends to prioritize immediate convenience at the expense of [长远利益/公众福祉/长效健康].

writing_corpus.expression: A closer scrutiny of the trade-offs reveals that neither alternative is inherently flawless.
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 双向辩证反思句
writing_corpus.translation: 对二者利弊的更深入审视表明，两种选择皆非毫无瑕疵、天衣无缝。
writing_corpus.application_sentence: A closer scrutiny of the trade-offs reveals that neither alternative is inherently flawless, necessitating a nuanced regulatory framework.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 对这两者之间利弊得失的更深入审视清晰表明，无论哪种方案都绝非尽善尽美，这就亟需建立更为精细审慎的监管框架。

paragraphs.text: It’s easy to dismiss as absurd the Trump administration’s ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks. Can anyone really think it’s a good idea to allow Amazon deliveries to your tent in Yosemite or food trucks to line up under the redwood trees at Sequoia National Park?
paragraphs.translation: 特朗普政府填补国家公园长期资金缺口的想法很容易被认为是荒谬的。有人真的认为让亚马逊送货到你在优胜美地的帐篷或让食品卡车在红杉国家公园的红杉树下排队是个好主意吗？

paragraphs.text: The real problem is that the parks have been chronically starved of funding. We conducted a comprehensive survey examining how U.S. residents view their national parks, and we found that Americans place a very high value on them—whether or not they actually visit them. The peer-reviewed economic survey of 700 U.S. taxpayers, conducted by mail and internet, also found that people would be willing to pay a significant amount of money to make sure the parks and their programs are kept intact. Some 81% of respondents said they would be willing to pay additional taxes for the next 10 years to avoid any cuts to the national parks.
paragraphs.translation: 真正的问题是公园长期缺乏资金。我们进行了一项全面的调查，了解美国居民如何看待他们的国家公园，我们发现美国人非常重视它们——无论他们是否真的参观过它们。通过邮件和互联网对 700 名美国纳税人进行的同行评审经济调查还发现，人们愿意支付大量资金来确保公园及其项目完好无损。约 81% 的受访者表示，他们愿意在未来 10 年内缴纳额外税款，以避免对国家公园的削减。

paragraphs.text: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature. On top of this, they produce value from their extensive educational programs, their positive impact on the climate through carbon sequestration, their contribution to our cultural and artistic life, and of course through tourism. The parks also help keep America’s past alive, working with thousands of local jurisdictions around the country to protect historical sites—including Ellis Island and Gettysburg—and to bring the stories of these places to life.
paragraphs.translation: 国家公园为美国居民提供了巨大的价值，既可以作为避世之地，也可以作为自然的象征。除此之外，他们还通过广泛的教育计划、通过碳固存对气候的积极影响、对我们的文化和艺术生活的贡献，当然还有旅游业的贡献来创造价值。这些公园还与全国数千个地方管辖区合作，保护历史遗迹（包括埃利斯岛和葛底斯堡），并让这些地方的故事栩栩如生，从而帮助保留美国的过去。

paragraphs.text: The parks do all this on a shoestring. Congress allocates only $3 billion a year to the national park system—an amount that has been flat since 2001 (in inflation-adjusted dollars) with the exception of a onetime boost in 2009 as part of the Obama stimulus package. Meanwhile, the number of annual visitors has increased by more than 50% since 1980, and now stands at 330 million visitors per year.
paragraphs.translation: 公园在小本经营的情况下完成这一切。国会每年只向国家公园系统拨款 30 亿美元，这一数额自 2001 年以来一直持平（按通货膨胀调整后的美元计算），除了 2009 年作为奥巴马经济刺激计划的一部分而一次性增加的资金外。与此同时，自1980年以来，每年游客数量增长了50%以上，目前每年游客数量达到3.3亿人次。

sentences.text: It’s easy to dismiss as absurd the Trump administration’s ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks.
sentences.translation: 特朗普政府填补国家公园长期资金缺口的想法很容易被认为是荒谬的。
sentences.slashed_text: It’s easy to dismiss as absurd the Trump administration’s ideas / for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks.
sentences.chunk_translation: 人们很容易将特朗普政府的设想斥为荒谬， / 那些旨在填补全美国家公园长期资金缺口的方案。

breakdown.content: It’s easy to dismiss as absurd the Trump administration’s ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为形式主语搭配宾语后置结构。形式主语代词 It；系动词 is；表语形容词 easy；动词不定式短语 to dismiss... 作真正的主语。在不定式内部，谓语动词 dismiss 后接介词短语 as absurd（视为荒唐荒谬，作宾语补足语），而由于真正宾语 the Trump administration’s ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks 较长，为避免头重脚轻进行了尾置（postposition of heavy object）。

breakdown.type: 长宾语后置与介词短语
breakdown.content: the Trump administration’s ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks
breakdown.explanation: 名词短语 the Trump administration’s ideas 充当 dismiss 的实际宾语，其后接介词短语 for plugging the chronic funding gap... 作后置功能定语；动名词 plugging（填补）带宾语 the chronic funding gap（长期存在的资金缺口），介词短语 of our national parks 界定缺口所属实体。

breakdown.content: dismiss as absurd the Trump administration’s ideas ... plugging the chronic funding gap
breakdown.explanation: 篇首靶子确立与叙事切入（Target Hook）。开篇直接将特朗普政府引入商业化私有化以解决公园财政赤字的想法斥为“荒诞不经（dismiss as absurd）”，确立批判基调，为后文批判营地私有化（Q27）以及引出真实财政解决之道（Q26、Q30）拉开论述大幕。

sentences.text: Can anyone really think it’s a good idea to allow Amazon deliveries to your tent in Yosemite or food trucks to line up under the redwood trees at Sequoia National Park?
sentences.translation: 有人真的认为让亚马逊送货到你在优胜美地的帐篷或让食品卡车在红杉国家公园的红杉树下排队是个好主意吗？
sentences.slashed_text: Can anyone really think it’s a good idea to allow Amazon deliveries to your tent / in Yosemite or food trucks to line up under the redwood trees / at Sequoia National Park?
sentences.chunk_translation: 真有人会觉得允许亚马逊将快递直接送到优胜美地的帐篷里， / 或者让快餐餐车排在红杉国家公园的参天红杉树下 / 是个好主意吗？

breakdown.content: Can anyone really think it’s a good idea to allow Amazon deliveries to your tent in Yosemite or food trucks to line up under the redwood trees at Sequoia National Park?
breakdown.explanation: 全句为主谓宾反问修辞结构。情态动词 Can + 主语 anyone + 副词 really + 谓语动词 think；其后接省略 that 的宾语从句 it’s a good idea to allow...。从句中 it 为形式主语，系动词 is，表语 a good idea，真正主语为不定式短语 to allow...；allow 后接两个由连词 or 并列的复合宾语结构（allow sb./sth. to do sth.）。

breakdown.content: allow Amazon deliveries to your tent ... or food trucks to line up under the redwood trees
breakdown.explanation: ① 第一复合宾语：Amazon deliveries（亚马逊外卖配送）为宾语，介词短语 to your tent in Yosemite（到你在优胜美地的帐篷）作地点状语；② 第二复合宾语：food trucks（流动餐车）为宾语，不定式短语 to line up under the redwood trees at Sequoia National Park（在红杉国家公园的红杉树下排起长队）作宾语补足语。

breakdown.content: Can anyone really think it’s a good idea ... Amazon deliveries ... food trucks
breakdown.explanation: 极具讽刺色彩的修辞反问（Rhetorical Question）。通过将“亚马逊外卖送进帐篷”和“餐车开进红杉树林”等荒唐商业入侵具象化，直接揭示商业化对国家公园原始宁静的粗暴践踏，生动伏笔 Q27 题眼（过度商业化私有化将破坏游客体验 spoil visitor experience）。

sentences.text: But the administration is right about one thing: U.S.

sentences.slashed_text: But the administration is right about one thing : / U.S.
sentences.chunk_translation: 但政府在一件事上确实说对了： / 全美

breakdown.content: But the administration is right about one thing: U.S.
breakdown.explanation: 本句为缩写点导致的断句片段（Sentence Fragment），在句法功能上充当下句主干的引出前提。转折连词 But 表让步转折；主语 the administration（政府）；系动词 is；表语形容词短语 right about one thing（在一件事上是正确的）；冒号用于引出下文解释说明的具体事实；专有名词 U.S. 为下句主语 national parks 的前置专有国家定语。

breakdown.content: one thing: U.S. [national parks are in crisis]
breakdown.explanation: 因专有名词缩写点（U.S.）被分词算法误切分。冒号后连接下句 SID 3 构成完整的同位语说明从句（即：美国国家公园正深陷危机）。作者在痛斥商业化方案后，客观承认政府所指出的“国家公园危机”这一现实判断确实切中要害。

breakdown.content: But the administration is right about one thing: U.S.
breakdown.explanation: 逻辑让步与议题聚焦（Concession）。承接前两句的冷嘲热讽，以 But 进行理性回调，将批判焦点从“荒谬的商业化手段”迅速拉回到“国家公园真实的生存困境”，为下文正式披露 120 亿美元基建危机（Q26）奠定逻辑跳板。

sentences.text: national parks are in crisis.
sentences.translation: 国家公园正处于危机之中。
sentences.slashed_text: national parks are / in crisis.
sentences.chunk_translation: 国家公园正 / 深陷危机之中。

breakdown.content: national parks are in crisis.
breakdown.explanation: 本句为接续上句 U.S. 的主干核心陈述句。主语为复数名词 national parks（与上句 U.S. 连为整体：美国国家公园）；系动词 are；表语为介词短语 in crisis（深陷危机之中）。

breakdown.content: are in crisis
breakdown.explanation: 介词短语 in crisis 作系动词 are 的表语，言简意赅地下达定论，将全美国家公园面临的系统性困境上升至生死存亡的“危机”高度。

breakdown.content: national parks are in crisis
breakdown.explanation: 段落核心主旨句（Paragraph Thesis）。用极其斩截有力的主系表短句宣布危机，直接引发下句关于百亿维护积压（maintenance backlog）的事实验证，是全文探讨国家公园基础设施崩溃与资金饥渴（Q26、Q30）的纲领性定调。

sentences.text: Collectively, they have a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion.
sentences.translation: 他们总共有超过 120 亿美元的维护积压。
sentences.slashed_text: Collectively , / they have a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion.
sentences.chunk_translation: 总计来看， / 它们积压的维修维护开支已超过120亿美元。

breakdown.content: Collectively, they have a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓宾结构。副词 Collectively（统而言之/总计来看）作句首评注性状语；主语代词 they（指代 U.S. national parks）；谓语动词 have；宾语名词短语 a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion（超过120亿美元的维护欠账/积压），介词短语 of more than $12 billion 作 backlog 的金额限定后置定语。

breakdown.content: maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion
breakdown.explanation: 名词 backlog 指累积未办的积压工作，maintenance backlog 特指公共资产因长期缺乏维护经费而堆积的维修欠账；数词短语 more than $12 billion 直观展示了财政欠账的极其骇人。

breakdown.content: maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion
breakdown.explanation: 命题核心题眼句（Q26正解定位句）。120 亿美元的维护积压是对上句 in crisis 的硬核数据佐证，直接同义对位 Q26 题答案 D（Poorly maintained infrastructure，维护严重不善的基础设施），同时彻底击碎 A 选项（商业利润下滑）与 B 选项（商业化不足）的偷换概念。

sentences.text: Roads, trails, restrooms, visitor centers and other infrastructure are crumbling.
sentences.translation: 道路、小径、卫生间、游客中心和其他基础设施都在崩溃。
sentences.slashed_text: Roads , / trails , / restrooms , / visitor centers and other infrastructure are crumbling.
sentences.chunk_translation: 道路、 / 步道、 / 公共洗手间、 / 游客中心以及其他基础设施正破败不堪。

breakdown.content: Roads, trails, restrooms, visitor centers and other infrastructure are crumbling.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主谓结构。主语由五个并列名词构成：Roads（道路）、trails（步道）、restrooms（公共洗手间）、visitor centers（游客中心）以及 other infrastructure（其他基础设施）；谓语动词 are crumbling 为现在进行时（crumble 为不及物动词，意为碎裂、坍塌、崩溃），生动描摹物理设施正在土崩瓦解的进行状态。

breakdown.content: Roads, trails, restrooms, visitor centers and other infrastructure
breakdown.explanation: 多名词连用排比，从路面步道到卫生间游客中心，全面覆盖公园最基础的公共服务设施；配合不及物动词 crumbling，构成立体画面感，强化危机迫在眉睫的窒息感。

breakdown.content: infrastructure are crumbling
breakdown.explanation: 具象论据与 Q26 考点印证。列举道路、公厕和基础设施的破败破损，与上一句的 maintenance backlog 形成“宏观数据+微观惨状”的合力论证，彻底确立 Q26 答案 D（Poorly maintained infrastructure），并排除了 C 选项（将路况破败以偏概全篡改为缺乏交通服务）。

sentences.text: But privatizing and commercializing the campgrounds would not be a cure-all.
sentences.translation: 但露营地私有化和商业化并不是万能药。
sentences.slashed_text: But privatizing and commercializing the campgrounds would not be a cure-all.
sentences.chunk_translation: 但将露营地私有化和商业化绝非万灵良药。

breakdown.content: But privatizing and commercializing the campgrounds would not be a cure-all.
breakdown.explanation: 主干为主系表结构。转折连词 But 表逻辑转向；主语由 and 连接的两个动名词短语构成：privatizing and commercializing the campgrounds（将露营地私有化和商业化，the campgrounds 为动名词的共同逻辑宾语）；情态动词 would not be 构成系动词短语（绝不会是）；表语 a cure-all（灵丹妙药/万能解药）。

breakdown.content: privatizing and commercializing the campgrounds
breakdown.explanation: privatizing（私有化）与 commercializing（商业化）两个动名词并列作主语，准确点明特朗普政府所开出的政策药方实质；名词 cure-all 带有强烈的否定评价色彩，指出该药方根本无法治愈百亿财政积压的沉疴。

breakdown.content: But privatizing and commercializing ... would not be a cure-all
breakdown.explanation: 承上启下转折论点（Transition & Core Thesis）。承接上段指出的基建危机，话锋一转严正反驳私有化方案。既在经济可行性上指出其于事无补，又在后文引出对游客体验的严重破坏，为 Q27 的深度考查奠定核心批驳支点。

sentences.text: Campgrounds are a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog, and concessionaires in the parks hand over, on average, only about 5% of their revenues to the National Park Service.
sentences.translation: 露营地只占整体基础设施积压的一小部分，公园特许经营商平均只将其收入的约 5% 上交给国家公园管理局。
sentences.slashed_text: Campgrounds are a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog , / and concessionaires in the parks hand over , / on average , / only about 5% of their revenues to the National Park Service.

breakdown.content: Campgrounds are a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog, and concessionaires in the parks hand over, on average, only about 5% of their revenues to the National Park Service.
breakdown.explanation: 全句由并列连词 and 连接两个表事实并列的分句。第一分句为主系表结构：主语 Campgrounds（露营地）；系动词 are；表语 a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog（整体基础设施维护积压中极微小的一部分）。第二分句为主谓宾结构：主语 concessionaires in the parks（公园内的特许经营商，介词短语作后置定语）；谓语动词短语 hand over（上交）；插入语 on average（平均而言）；宾语 only about 5% of their revenues（其营业收入的仅约5%）；介词短语 to the National Park Service（给国家公园管理局）作方向宾语。

breakdown.content: on average, only about 5% of their revenues
breakdown.explanation: 插入语 on average 增强数据的统计严密性；副词 only 与介词 about 强化限定，揭示特许商给公园管理局的分成比例低得可怜（仅5%），从经济账本上彻底证明商业化无法填补百亿资金缺口。

breakdown.content: tiny portion ... hand over ... only about 5% of their revenues
breakdown.explanation: 经济可行性证伪（Economic Disproof）。从“客体占比微不足道（tiny portion）”和“收益分成极度悬殊（only 5%）”两个维度，用冷酷的财务算账将“私有化解决资金缺口”的幻想砸得粉碎，直接反证商业化方案的破产。

breakdown.content: The real problem is that the parks have been chronically starved of funding.
